title: ProgramManifest
description: Declared runnable program / variant: what it implements, what it excludes, which artifacts compose it, and optional I/O contracts for shopping and composition.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema file

id.description: Stable program id (e.g. tipunch:program:pm_field_v2 or product_family_leaf)

label.description: Human shopping name — name the sandwich, not the missing ingredient

why.description: Written rationale: who, what journey, what wedge

kind.description: program = runnable leaf; network = declared set of related programs (compose_from = members)

variant_of.description: Parent program id for inherit/patch; null for root variants

network.description: Parent program-network id when this leaf belongs to a network

role.description: Primary actor (e.g. pm, sub, dispatcher, admin)

flow.description: Logical route to flow JSON (flowerpot / hostpark path)

launch.description: Logical route to launch HTML fragment

entry.description: First in-app route key (must match flow.entry)

layers.description: UX spectrum placement — which artifacts sit at each level (L0, L1, L2, …)

feature_imps.description: Feature tokens this program implements (viewport / launch_index shopping)

feature_excludes.description: Optional explicit non-goals — keeps baseline flows unpolluted

modules.description: Module mounts relative to project flowerpot root

mount.description: Extra L2/L5 parks to mount at launch (e.g. photo bin module)

artifact_contracts.description: Standard I/O: what each artifact provides and requires — enables isolated testing and later compose-all

provides.description: Capability tokens or API surfaces this artifact exports

requires.description: Capabilities or tips another artifact must supply

consumes.description: Data shapes read (schema ids, tip keys)

emits.description: Data shapes written or events emitted

compose.description: Optional cross-family composition map (typed ids) — see composition.md

compose_from.description: Program ids merged to build this runtime (future suite / all-features variant)

test_hint.description: Short QA path for launch_index / viewport

flowerpot_root.description: Project publish prefix when id is project-local
